Very misleading. Great UI and very easy to use but they hold your resume hostage until you pay for a subscription. After arduously creating a profile and typing everything out I was unable to export without paying for a subscription. Additionally you cannot screenshot without the entire resume disappearing. To those who don’t have the money for even a small subscription this is incredibly frustrating. I would rather have ads shoved in my face than be forced to pay just to be able to use the resume I created. Maybe the developers should try being honest and upfront and actually advertise “easily use free templates but give us money or else you will never see your resume again”

Looks good and easy. I found this resume builder to be very easy to use. You have multiple templates to choose from with different designs and you can opt to add a headshot on your resume. There is a profile template where you can add information for sections such as work experience, education, skills, etc. Very straightforward. To save the resume obviously you have to pay a subscription fee which the cheapest is $4.99 for a one week subscription which allows you to quickly build and edit a resume. There are other monthly and annual subscription options.
